The *Sodhanahāravibhaṅga* ("Conveying a Clearing Up: Analysis") constitutes the sixteenth section (Ne 16) of the *Nettippakaraṇa* in the Pali canon [SuttaCentral]. It presents an analytical treatment of the interpretive mode or conveyance known as *sodhana-hāra* within the hermeneutical framework of the *Netti* [SuttaCentral].

SuttaCentral notes cross-references and relations between the *Sodhanahāravibhaṅga* and various canonical and post-canonical texts, including the *Ajitamāṇavapucchā* (Snp 5.2), the *Cūḷaniddesa* (*Pucchā*, Cnd 2; *Ajitamāṇavapucchāniddesa*, Cnd 5), the *Vicayahāravibhaṅga* (Ne 5), the *Peṭakopadesa* (Pe 1 and Pe 5), and the Sanskrit *Śarīrārthagāthā* [SuttaCentral]. DharmaNexus confirms substantial text reuse across these works, showing extensive shared material between this text and the *Ajitamāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 5, with segments §8.1–11.3 matching Cnd 5 §34.1–36.2) and the *Vicayahāravibhaṅga* (Ne 5, §1.3–3.5 matching Ne 5 §4.4_0–6.5), as well as matches with Snp 5.2 and Cnd 2 [DharmaNexus]. In cross-language alignments, DharmaNexus detects strong reuse with the Sanskrit *Śarīrārthagāthā* (notably §3.2–3.3 matching verse 150), concurring with SuttaCentral's record, alongside lower-scoring alignments with the Tibetan *Anavataptanāgarājaparipṛcchā-mahāyāna-sūtra* (D0156) and the Chinese *Saṃyuktāgama* (T 99) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also records substantial internal reuse in Pali commentaries, including the *Nettivibhāvinī*, the *Nettippakaraṇa-aṭṭhakathā*, and the *Cūḷaniddesa-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus].
